summary: Tested Aurem Loop /harness Phase A content pipeline in the current not-yet-seeded state. Backend (live public URL): /api/harness/page-status returns {harness_page_enabled:false} by default; /api/harness/content returns 200 {content:{available:false}, live_stats:{stars:16, forks:2}} (ints, matching api.github.com live values); no token leak; /both 301 -> /; /, /harness, /vs, /compare, /about all return 200. 12/12 pytest pass (9 new live + 3 existing ASGI). Frontend flag OFF (desktop + mobile): /harness shows ora-nav + 'Aurem Loop isn't available yet.' (harness-page-not-available), no download text, no chooser strip/promo on /, /vs /compare /about render, 0 console errors/pageerrors. Flag ON (temp upsert + backend restart): page-status true; /harness shows harness-page-content-unavailable with exact text "Aurem Loop's page content is temporarily unavailable — check back shortly.", 0 download mentions; homepage strip shows 'ORA by AUREM' (active, non-link) + 'AUREM LOOP harness' -> /harness, clicking it navigates correctly; promo line reads exactly 'A local coding harness that checks its own work. Not available to download yet.'; 0 console errors. Flag reverted (doc deleted, backend restarted, page-status false again, verified in browser).

minor.issue: Code and docstring disagree. _token()'s docstring says the repo is public for now (confirmed: GET api.github.com/repos/AuremHQ/aurem-loop returns 200) and that reads should go ahead unauthenticated with token=None. But fetch_harness_page_content() returns {available:false} early with `if not token:` and never tries the read. AUREM_LOOP_REPO_TOKEN is not in backend/.env. Result: even after the founder pushes web/harness-page-content.json to the public repo (for example through the GitHub web UI), /harness will stay 'temporarily unavailable' until a PAT is configured. Also, the warning 'is not configured' is logged on every request (nothing is cached on failure).

issues: The CTA button (data-testid=aurem-loop-promo-cta) says 'Get Aurem Loop →', right under the line 'Not available to download yet.' 'Get' suggests a download, which conflicts with the Phase A no-download rule. Consider 'Join the waitlist →' or 'Learn about Aurem Loop →'.
A single line of text on an otherwise empty page, with no link back or waitlist CTA. Acceptable for fail-closed, but it could include the waitlist mailto and a link home.

With the flag ON, the prerendered /harness HTML serves the generic ORA homepage <title> and <main> copy, not Aurem Loop copy. Probably expected while the content is unavailable, but crawlers would index ORA copy under /harness.

action_items: Decide whether harness_content_repo should read the content file without a token while the repo is public (drop the `if not token` early return, or call fetch_file with token=None), or fix the docstring. Otherwise, seeding the file alone won't make the page go live.
Optional: change the promo CTA wording 'Get Aurem Loop →' to non-download wording for Phase A.
critical_code_review_comments: harness_content_repo.py: the 'no token' path returns {available:false} without trying an unauthenticated read, contradicting the _token() docstring (see the minor backend issue).

harness_content_repo.py and wsp_kit_stats.py: failures are not negatively cached, so with no token or during a GitHub outage every /harness/content request logs a warning. Each wsp-kit failure also makes an outbound GitHub call (60 req/h unauthenticated limit). Consider caching the failure briefly.
routers/harness.py /harness/content: the two fetches run one after the other; asyncio.gather would cut latency (up to 10s timeout each).
HarnessPage.jsx: the 'error' contentState (network failure) renders the same unavailable message. That's fine, but the 'Refresh now' button only exists in the ready state.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_harness_phase_a_live.py (new test-only file; no app code changed)
seed_data_creation: Temporarily upserted {flag:'harness_page', enabled:true} in feature_flags (no such doc existed before). Deleted it afterward (deleted 1), restarted backend, and verified page-status=false and the browser OFF state. The final state matches the start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toggle the flag with `python3 /app/backend/tests/harness_flag_toggle.py on|off|show`, then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and wait about 16-20s. Set EXPECT_HARNESS_ON=1 when the flag is ON; once real content is seeded, the test_content_fail_closed assertion must be updated. AuremHQ/aurem-loop is currently public; web/harness-page-content.json returns 404 there. Full vitest and full backend suites were NOT re-run by me.
